title: Under a hold the chat mirror carries the held profile while the page shows the old one; a sex or height the chat proposes from it is checked against the page's form, not the held profile, and its banner's Save writes it, the value shown in the banner
evidence: Root fix R13 PR 3 (2026-11-25), US-34 AC9: an own save's values read writes the page's saved profile (useProfileSave savedProfile) into the mirror while the relay holds a change (remote-replay holding), asked as the mirror is written; the read that ends the hold writes the applied record once. Pin flipped: HealthTool.record-read-pins.test.tsx "US-34 AC4a (today, follow-up flips): under a hold the chat mirror carries the held profile" became "US-34 AC9 (H15): under a hold, an own save's read leaves the chat's context on the profile the page shows". Tests: record-read-pins (context keys unchanged, hold end writes once, banner checked against the form), useRecordReads.test, useRecordApply.test, remote-replay.test.
